title: What Does a Temporal Benchmark Score Measure? Decomposing Channel Use in Video VLM Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2607.12304v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A score on a temporal video question answering benchmark is meant to measure that a model has temporal understanding, but it conflates two questions. (1)~is the question even temporal, does it need several frames and their order? And (2)~when it does, does the model recover the order from the pixels, or read it off the positional encoding (RoPE)? Most of a temporal score answers neither, since a single frame and answer priors often carry it, and the field's validity checks, frame-shuffle sensitivity and multi-frame gain, speak only to (1). For (2) we score a reversal conflict, frames reversed while RoPE stays forward, two ways: label-free, as the accuracy lost against the forward labels, and against reversed labels wherever labels transform deterministically under time reversal. translated_title: 时序基准分数到底衡量了什么？分解视频视觉语言模型评估中的通道使用
translated_abstract: 时序视频问答基准上的分数本应衡量模型是否具备时序理解能力，但它混淆了两个问题：（1）该问题是否真的是时序性的，是否需要多帧及其先后顺序？（2）如果是，模型是从像素中恢复出顺序，还是直接从位置编码（RoPE）中读取顺序？时序分数的大部分内容对这两个问题都无法回答，因为单帧和答案先验往往就足以支撑分数，而该领域现有的有效性检验手段——帧打乱敏感性和多帧增益——只涉及问题（1）。针对问题（2），我们用两种方式对“反转冲突”（即帧序被反转而RoPE仍保持正向）进行评分：一种是无标签方式，即以相对正向标签的准确率损失来衡量；另一种是在标签在时间反转下可确定性变换时，以相对反转标签的准确率来衡量。这能够将真正跟随反转内容的模型与仅仅被干扰的模型区分开来。这两种解读在两种模……（原文截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“反转冲突”评测方法（帧序反转而RoPE保持正向），将时序视频VLM基准分数分解为“任务是否真正需要时序信息”与“模型是从像素还是位置编码获取时序”两个通道，从而区分真正理解时序的模型与仅仅被干扰的模型。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a "reversal conflict" evaluation (frames reversed while RoPE stays forward) to decompose temporal video-VLM benchmark scores, separating whether a task truly requires temporal information from whether a model reads order from pixels versus positional encoding, and distinguishing models that follow reversed content from those merely disrupted.
